My Eulogy to SurvivorType:

When I joined voat, it was out of curiosity and seeking out new kinships. I made an introduction post, and @raisin told me to come check out v/PromptoftheDay.

I think there were only 5 of us posting around that time. I was so scared. See, I had fallen into this depressive state of mind where I just couldn't write.

In the past 2 years, prior to meeting @SurvivorType, I wrote maybe 4 pages worth of material. I just felt so downtrodden and sad. Then comes SurvivorType, aka "dad" as I called him. He and a few others gave me the confidence, and most importantly, the acceptance I was missing prior to this.

Over the next few months, we forged a friendship. I can honestly say he was one of the best, most influential voaters out there. He'd help me with not only writing, but even when I was struggling with another round of crippling depression. I would get frustrated. "I can't write anything. I can't even think." I'd say. He'd just say "not to worry about it, it's still there. You just need to clear your mind a bit."

He'd tell me stories about his youth, back when he was my age, or just what was happening. Eventually we got more users in on our funny little family. Eventually, though, they all left. But he stayed.

Then he'd get on less frequently. I would see him less, and spoke rarely. At one point, I considered leaving and he convinced me not to. He gave me his sub, the sub I loved so much, and continued to contribute.

I logged onto voat today with a message from him telling me goodbye. I am not ashamed to admit i teared up a bit. My heart sank down to my stomach and it felt so heavy.

So, ST, if you log on again, I want you to know that you have had a profound impact on me. Thanks for keeping the hate at bay, always encouraging me, and others, to pursue our passions. You're a great teacher, and I'm proud to call you my friend.

Love,
